title: Fines catalogue – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Fines catalogue
hero.lead: The catalogue contains chargeable fines and credited rewards. Authorised users maintain the rules and assign an entry to a player. The entry then appears in that player’s personal account.

body:
Read the catalogue

  • The name and the line below explain the reason.
  • The amount is red with a minus sign for a fine and green with a plus sign for a reward.
  • Type distinguishes fines from rewards.
  • Validity shows the defined period or Unlimited.
  • Scope shows whether the type applies globally, to a club or to a team.

Create a new type

  1. Select New type.
  2. Enter the name in the club language marked as the default. Use Add another language to add translations.
  3. Add a description in the same way if the name does not fully explain the reason.
  4. Enter a positive numerical value under Amount (€).
  5. Select Fine or Reward. Kaderblick applies the minus or plus sign according to this type.
  6. Optionally set Valid from and Valid until.
  7. Select Global, Club or Team as the scope, followed by the specific club or team. The scopes offered depend on your permissions.
  8. Use Active to control whether the type can be selected for new assignments, then select Create.

Manage an existing type

The following actions appear at the end of a row for types within your area of responsibility:

  • The Active switch activates or deactivates the type.
  • The pencil opens the same details for editing.
  • The bin opens a confirmation prompt before deletion.

Global types can only be changed with global administration permission. Team and club types can only be managed within the areas offered to you.

Assign a fine or reward

  1. Open the Assign fine tab.
  2. Select Assign fine or reward.
  3. If you are authorised for several teams, select the team first.
  4. Select the player, followed by the active fine or reward type.
  5. Check the date and add an optional note.
  6. Review the summary and confirm the assignment.

The tab also contains the assignment history with player, type, amount, date, team, note and the person who recorded it. The entire tab is absent without assignment permission.

Differences by role

  • Coaches with assignment permission: can assign entries to players in the teams offered to them and see the history.
  • People with catalogue administration permission: additionally receive New type and the activate, edit and delete actions for their area of responsibility.
  • Players, parents and supporters: can see the released catalogue; administration and assignment actions require additional permission.
  • Global administration: can create and manage global types.

Related areas

  • An assignment creates a personal item under My balance.
  • Payments and adjustments are recorded in the cashbook.
  • Team and club scopes use the assignments from Clubs & teams.
